scenarios_note: Each eval is also executed by evals/run_tests.py against real CLI scripts in a disposable fake agent home. 'expectations' are the machine-checkable and judge-checkable criteria.

evals.prompt: 帮我看下 https://github.com/acme/awesome-skills 这个仓库是 Skill 还是 Plugin，装之前要检查什么？
evals.expected_output: Classifies the URL as a repository that must be cloned before the type is known, explains the skill/plugin classification signals, runs environment detection first, lists the security checks, and does not guess paths.
expectations: Runs scan_agents.py before planning an install
Uses detect_resources.py --url and explains the clone-then-classify step
Names the classification signals for skill (SKILL.md) vs plugin manifests
Mentions security scan findings that require confirmation
Does not claim a DSH Plugin or native install API exists

evals.prompt: 把这个 GitHub 上的 Skill 下载下来，并同步到 DSH、Codex 和 Claude Code。
evals.expected_output: Executes the full pipeline: classify/import into the central library, distribute to the three tools, verify hashes, report per-tool results and any unverified steps.
expectations: Imports into the central library before distributing
Uses sync_resources.py --direction distribute with three --agent flags
Verifies each target with verify_sync.py
Reports per-tool status and does not claim success without verification
Explains the conflict policy if any copy differs

evals.prompt: 检查六个 AI 工具，把各自新增的 Skill 导入中央资源库，并报告版本冲突。
evals.expected_output: Runs import direction over all six tools, separates new / updated / skipped / conflicted, explains states A-F, leaves conflicts untouched and offers resolutions.
expectations: Runs sync_resources.py --direction import for all tools
Distinguishes imported / imported-update / skip / conflict
Explains state B (target changed) vs state C (both changed)
Does not overwrite the library on conflicts
Offers the four resolution options

evals.prompt: Claude Code 里的 demo-notes 和中央库不一样了，但我也改过中央库，现在两边都有我的改动，怎么办？
evals.expected_output: Identifies a state C conflict, shows the diff, explains the four resolutions, requests a decision, then verifies after resolving.
expectations: Recognises a two-sided conflict (state C)
Runs compare_resources.py with a diff
Presents keep-library / keep-target / manual-merge / new-version
Asks before overwriting either side
Verifies after resolution

evals.prompt: 把这个 Claude Code 的插件装到 Codex 上，再顺手复制到 Gemini。
evals.expected_output: Refuses cross-tool plugin copying, explains per-tool plugin packaging, offers the target tool's real install mechanism and notes unverified paths.
expectations: Refuses to copy plugin files across tools
Explains that plugins are tool-specific packages
Returns the real per-tool install command instead
Detects whether Gemini is installed before promising anything
Does not fabricate a plugin install API

evals.prompt: 我机器上 Codex 只有配置目录没有 CLI，Claude Code 也有；帮我确认每个工具的实际状态和 Skill 目录。
evals.expected_output: Reports installed/config-only/absent per tool with versions and resolved skill directories, marks verification levels, and never creates directories for absent tools.
expectations: Runs scan_agents.py
Distinguishes installed from config-only and absent
Reports verification level per tool
Warns when a path is unverified instead of presenting it as fact

evals.prompt: 我要在一台新机器上重建我的 AI 工具链，把中央库里的 Skill 全部同步到所有兼容工具，并且别覆盖我已有的文件。
evals.expected_output: Plans a dry-run batch distribution, explains conflict states and backups, executes idempotently, verifies, and reports anything skipped for manual handling.
expectations: Runs a dry run before writing
Uses --all with conflict policy skip by default
Explains backups and state A/B/C/D/E
Verifies and reports skipped/manual items honestly

evals.prompt: 同步以后 Codex 里少了一个文件，Claude Code 里有人改过 SKILL.md，怎么查？
evals.expected_output: Runs verify_sync.py, interprets missing/changed lists, explains drift vs conflict, and proposes repair direction only after asking.
expectations: Runs verify_sync.py with --include-unmanaged or per resource
Interprets drifted with missing and changed file lists
Explains that repair direction is a user decision
Runs compare_resources.py before changing anything

evals.prompt: 恢复 demo-notes 的上一版，并告诉我恢复了哪个 hash。
evals.expected_output: Lists versions/backups, restores the selected version, reports the restored hash and that the restore is undoable.
expectations: Lists versions or backups before restoring
Uses backup_restore.py restore with a version label or backup id
Reports the restored hash
Mentions the pre-restore snapshot/backup

evals.prompt: 从 PR 里下载这个 skill 到我的库里，但是我看它安装脚本里在 curl 一个 URL，安全吗？
evals.expected_output: Runs the security review, explains the specific high-risk pattern, blocks the import pending confirmation, and offers a safer path.
expectations: Runs the safety scan and quotes file/line evidence
Explains why piping a download into a shell is high risk
Requires explicit confirmation before importing
Suggests inspecting/removing the script or a safer alternative
Does not import silently

evals.prompt: 把中央库的 MCP server demo-fetch 装到 Claude Code 和 Codex，我的 API key 别弄丢了。
evals.expected_output: Explains secret redaction with ${ENV_VAR} placeholders, writes the Claude JSON config, marks Codex TOML as manual, and instructs the user to export the env var.
expectations: Redacts the API key into a ${ENV_NAME} placeholder
Writes the Claude JSON MCP config with a backup
Marks Codex as manual TOML editing
Tells the user to export the env var and restart
Never prints or stores the raw key

evals.prompt: 我装了同一个 Skill 的旧版和新版，怎么对比差异再决定用哪个？
evals.expected_output: Compares version snapshots or two paths, shows file-level differences and unified diff, then guides restore of the chosen version.
expectations: Uses compare_resources.py with resource@version operands
Reports file-level differences and unified diff
Explains how to restore the chosen version
Does not overwrite current content without confirmation

evals.prompt: 把所有工具里新增的 skill 都导入，但不要动我手动改过的 Codex 版本。
evals.expected_output: Imports per tool, treats the edited Codex copy as state B/C, preserves manual edits as new versions or conflicts, and reports what was left untouched.
expectations: Runs per-tool import
Distinguishes target-only changes from two-sided conflicts
Preserves manual edits as a version snapshot
Does not delete or overwrite the Codex copy
Reports untouched items

evals.prompt: 同步过程中断过一次，现在再跑会不会重复安装或者生成一堆备份？
evals.expected_output: Explains idempotency and the journal, demonstrates a --resume run, and shows that identical content is skipped without new backups.
expectations: Explains content hashing and skip-on-identical
Mentions staging/journal-*.json and --resume
Runs or proposes a dry run first
Reports backup counts / unchanged state as evidence

evals.prompt: 这个 skill 的 SKILL.md 里 name 写成了 Demo Notes，能装吗？
evals.expected_output: Reports the validation error (kebab-case and folder mismatch), refuses by default, and only imports with explicit --force plus a clear warning.
expectations: Detects invalid kebab-case name
Explains why some tools silently fail to load it
Refuses without --force
Documents the risk when forcing
